what: a greater soul sphere, an ancient vessel for holding a grown spirit: one round globe of thick dark smoky glass as big as two fists, held in a cage of two thick hoops of bright polished silver. Both hoops run from the top of the globe to the bottom, like the lines of longitude on a map globe: they cross each other at the very top and at the very bottom and nowhere else, so that the glass shows between them in four tall curved panes. At the top where the hoops cross is a small silver cap with one small silver ring standing on it; at the bottom where they cross is a small silver knob. Inside the glass, in its very middle, burns one bright round ball of soul-light the size of a plum, brilliant white at its heart and bright sky blue around it, lighting the glass around it a glowing pale blue from inside. The glow stays inside the glass.
colours: Dark smoky blue-black glass lit pale blue from inside, with a white glint; bright polished silver hoops, cap and ring with white highlights; a brilliant white and sky-blue ball of light in the middle.
pose: Seen from the front and a little to one side, upright, the small ring at the top.
must_show: one round dark glass globe
two bright silver hoops running top to bottom, crossing at the top and bottom
a bright round ball of white-blue light in the middle, much brighter than a faint wisp
small silver ring on top
must_not_show: rays reaching out of the glass
upper half one colour and lower half another

what: a master sphere, the greatest vessel for holding a spirit: one perfectly round globe of thick clear crystal glass as big as two fists, exactly as wide as it is tall, round like a ball at the top and round at the bottom, held in a cage of FOUR thick hoops of bright polished silver. All four hoops run from the top of the globe to the bottom, like the lines of longitude on a map globe, evenly spaced: they meet at the very top and at the very bottom and nowhere else, so the glass shows between them in eight tall curved panes. At the top where the hoops meet is a silver cap shaped like a small crown with four short points, and one silver ring standing in the middle of it; under the round bottom of the globe sits only one tiny flat round silver button, with no point. Inside, the whole globe blazes with soul-light: a dazzling white star of light fills its middle, with short straight beams of white light reaching from it to the inside of the glass in every direction, so the entire globe glows brilliant white and pale ice blue. The light stays inside the glass. The four hoops are drawn thick, in polished steel darker than the glowing glass, with a dark edge, so the cage stands out clearly against the light inside. The crown is wide and low: a ring of four short plain rounded points with nothing on their tips, sitting flat on top of the globe, and in the middle of it one small round loop for a cord, as wide as a third of the globe.
colours: Crystal glass blazing white and pale ice blue from inside; bright polished silver hoops and crown cap with white highlights; a dazzling white star of light filling the middle.
pose: Seen from the front and a little to one side, upright, the crown cap at the top.
must_show: one round glass globe glowing brilliant white all through
four silver hoops meeting at the top and bottom, more than two
small silver crown-shaped cap with a ring on top
a dazzling star of white light with short beams inside the glass
must_not_show: beams or rays outside the glass

what: a hearth sphere, an ancient vessel that holds a spirit from home: one round globe of thick dark smoky glass as big as two fists, held in a cage of two thick hoops of dark iron, each hoop edged along both sides with a thin bright line of gold. Both hoops run from the top of the globe to the bottom, like the lines of longitude on a map globe: they cross each other at the very top and at the very bottom and nowhere else, so that the glass shows between them in four tall curved panes. At the top where the hoops cross is a small cap of bright gold with one small gold ring standing on it; at the bottom where they cross is a small gold knob. Inside the glass, in its middle, swirls one soft wisp of warm soul-light, coiled like a twist of smoke, pale cream white at its heart and soft honey gold at its edges, like the last glow of a fire at home.
colours: Dark smoky blue-black glass with a white glint; dark charcoal iron hoops edged with thin bright gold lines; bright yellow gold cap, ring and knob; a coiled wisp of cream white and honey gold light inside.
pose: Seen from the front and a little to one side, upright, the small gold ring at the top.
must_show: one round dark glass globe
two iron hoops running top to bottom, edged with gold
gold cap and gold ring on top
soft swirling wisp of warm golden light inside
must_not_show: upper half one colour and lower half another
